profile.headline: Full-stack .NET developer adept at customer-facing app development,  web server administration, testing and optimization

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Support business requirements regarding web applications, including a highly visible brand content/ecommerce website. Direct interaction with all levels within the organization and business partners required involvement in all phases of the project development cycle from concept, design to implementation.

Implemented a restructured solution which included converting the website to a mobile friendly web application running on .Net 4.5

Improved online presence by implementing modern SEO strategies and working with 3rd party APIs

Replaced an outdated shopping cart with a modern, streamlined and PCI compliant solution (PayPal payflow integration) 

Regularly created online content for brand marketing campaigns including the Pantone Color of the Year. 

Created and implemented shared  a web services accessed by various applications within the organization (ASMX, WCF)

Added controls and functions to existing CMS, broadening website updating capabilities for staff (SiteCore, homegrown CMS)

positions.title: Business Analyst/Web Applications Developer
positions.description:
Designed and created programming specifications for web based applications that met specific business requirements 
Utilized critical thinking skills to solve problems creatively and overcome obstacles in a fast past environment utilizing Rapid Application Development and Scrum methodologies. 
Worked directly with partners/vendors to ensure insurance premium calculations were correct and/or interactions with our software met specifications. 
Incorporated modern front end technology to existing web applications that were outdated. This included full website re-facing and ajax technology with web services.  Using the Jquery library and modern CSS techniques, customer experience was increased
Created a Single Sign On token process for a joint initiative with vendors. Involved creating logic in web service that when called, would store time sensitive encrypted token strings into SQL database. The token would allow access to customer account when signed in from vendor’s website.

positions.title: Applications Developer/IT Manager
positions.description:
Application Development
Redesigned current company website and incorporated modern technology ie, JQuery, Javascript, and web services while complying with XHTML standards for cross-browser compatibility.
Implemented an in-house web server using IIS to host ASP.NET web sites and FTP sites for the company’s 4 divisions. Manage an in-house SQL server for e-commerce and data-driven websites, designed relational databases based upon the needs of each individual website, utilized views and stored procedures for reporting purposes and security.
Debug, manage, and implement new features for a windows application using the .NET platform and C# to allow employees to update data for each website, and view custom reports written for sales, accounting, and executive personnel. Reports were written using Crystal Reports, C#, Excel ODBC, and Excel pivot tables.
Implemented a multi-tier application architecture to allow websites to communicate securely with the ERP system to allow for B2B and B2C applications such as real-time inventory, pricing, discounts, dealer locators, sales orders, purchase orders, return authorization, and product registration.
Implemented an in-house photo and video studio, designed a workflow, and trained users on how to use the camera equipment, and process the media so that the photos and videos will be ready for email, ftp downloads, websites, and catalog creation. Wrote software that streamlined the process of converting images and uploading them to ftp and web servers with the click of a button.

Various Network Administration tasks

company.name: Sunjeen (Protec Music / BLVD / The Nail Genie)

positions.title: Graphic Designer/IT Specialist/Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Design and create communication and benefits materials, such as brochures, booklets, and postcards. 
•	Format, design, and send out e-blasts to members and trustees. 
•	Serve as the Webmaster for company website, including providing solutions for “contact us” messages.  
•	Writing complex SQL queries and stored procedures for Microsoft SQL Server. Using SQL queries to implement and maintain the use of interactive and online forms with Formatta forms manager.  
•	Use of Crystal Reports for various assignments. 
•	Combining complex formulas and existing data to create excel worksheets projecting pension supplementation.
•	As a member of the IT team, provide solutions and assistance for internal issues regarding network, hardware, and web issues. 
•	Maintain and update company’s Microsoft Active Directory. 
•	Position also required working with ASP.net, CSS (hand coding), HTML (hand coding), JAVASCRIPT, XML, SQL Server.
